7e239723: If the 5th piece of DQ(DQ) does not start with '$', and X is a valid number, and the 5th-99th pieces of DQ(DQ) contain '+X'=X', set X to its numeric value.
c94ee10f: Execute the code label X_DQ. Kill the YS array.

f9e5d99b: Kill DIC('S') and DLAYGO. If X is defined and not equal to undefined, and if DE(DW,'INDEX') is defined, execute SAVEVALS. If KEYCHK returns false, execute UNIQFERR^DIE17. Set DG(DW) to X. If DV contains 'd', set ^DISV(DUZ,'DIE',DLB) to X. Go to the A label.
00b8d069: If ZTQUEUED is not defined, write a '??' character and a beep. If DB(DQ) is defined, go to the Z^DIE17 label.
c86b2a80: Set X to '?BAD'.
7d4aeb28: Set DZ to X. Execute the D and QQ^DIEQ subroutines. Go to the B label.
7f2cea51: Set D to DIFLD. Set DQ(DQ) to DLB_U_DV_U_DU_U_DW_U_pieces 2-99 of the $T(@('X'_DQ)) string. Quit.

cfb27680: If DE(DQ) is not defined, execute the O subroutine. If X does not equal '@', go to the RD label. If DV does not contain 'R' and X equals '@', go to the A label. If X equals '@', set X to Y. Go to the N label.
c630ab47: Set DG to DV. Set Y to DE(DQ). Set X to DU. If DQ(DQ,2) is defined, execute DQ(DQ,2). Go to the RP label.

de03647f: If DG contains 'P' and the global node ^X(0) exists, set X to the 2nd piece of ^(0). If ^(Y,0) does not exist, go to the RP label. Set Y to the 1st piece of ^(0). Set X to the 3rd piece of ^DD(X,.01,0). Set DG to the 2nd piece of ^(0). Go to the R label.

3ed6745f: If DG contains 'V', Y is numeric, the 2nd piece of Y (after ';') contains '(', and the global node @(U_2nd piece of Y_'0)') exists, set X to the 2nd piece of ^(0). If ^(+Y,0) does not exist, go to the RP label. Set Y to the 1st piece of ^(0). If ^DD(+X,.01,0) exists, set DG to the 2nd piece of ^(0) and X to the 3rd piece of ^(0). Go to the R label.
